parameters.content:
## W1 - Prospect scraper & scorer

Mondays 08:00 + manual trigger for testing. Per run:
1. **SerpAPI Google Maps** search per vertical (centered on Azusa), plus **Apollo people-search** when a key is configured. Apollo is the only source that returns a named decision maker; SerpAPI returns the business. A vertical fails only if BOTH come back empty.
   Apollo is opt-in and its FREE plan has no API access at all. `sh ~/sanaku.sh set APOLLO_KEY <key>` then re-import: the installer creates the credential and turns `useApollo` on. Never flip that flag by hand - true without a credential fails mid-run.
2. Apollo runs TWO passes per vertical: by seniority (owner/founder/c_suite/partner/vp/director - who signs) and by explicit title (Office Manager, Dispatcher, COO... - who runs the phones day to day at a bigger operation). Which one represents a company is decided per vertical, not globally: an office manager is the de-facto approver at a dental practice and a gatekeeper at a plumbing shop, on the identical title.
3. Dedupe against existing prospects (domain + phone) BEFORE any scraping
4. robots.txt check -> fetch site (SanakuBot UA, 10s timeout, 3 retries) -> detect chat/booking/CRM/ads/forms signals + scrape a contact email off the page
5. Score maturity (0 = no automation = best) + intent (0-100) -> tier (unknown size = neutral +10, not a penalty)
6. If Apollo is enabled: reveal decision-maker contacts, best-ranked first (per-vertical authority, then intent), up to `maxRevealsPerRun` (installer sets it from APOLLO_REVEALS, default 25). Every reveal also requests Apollo's `personal_emails` field at no extra cost - stored SEPARATELY as `contact_email_personal`, shown on the dashboard, never fed to W2's automated sender (that reads `contact_email` only - a shared sending identity is not something to risk on Apollo's sparser, unverified personal data). A prospect with no email is never contacted by W2, so unused reveal budget is lost pipeline.
7. Direct-dial/mobile phone reveal is a SEPARATE, much smaller budget - confirmed live at 8 credits/reveal, not 1 like email. `maxPhoneRevealsPerRun` (installer sets it from APOLLO_PHONE_REVEALS, default 6) takes the front of the SAME best-first list already chosen for email - never a phone reveal for someone we did not already email-reveal. It's async: Apollo can take several minutes, so this run only KICKS IT OFF (`phone_reveal_request_id` stored on the row); a side-branch off Run Config ("Get Pending Phone Reveals" -> ... -> "Log Phone Reveal Giveup") resolves requests from PRIOR runs at the start of each new one - polling is free, confirmed live. Success writes `contact_phone_source: 'apollo_direct'`; failure or 7 days of silence gives up and logs why rather than polling forever.
8. Upsert to `sanaku_prospects` (cap 50 new/run), email me a digest with top 10 Tier 1 + why they scored

Tune caps in `Run Config`. Dead sites/API failures log to `sanaku_errors` and never kill the run.

Credentials: "Supabase Service Role (Custom Auth)" (apikey + Authorization Bearer), optional "Apollo API Key (Header Auth)", "Gmail Account" (OAuth2).
Env: SUPABASE_URL, SANAKU_OWNER_EMAIL, SERPAPI_KEY (required), APOLLO_KEY (optional, paid plan only).

Apollo search endpoint is `mixed_people/api_search`, NOT `mixed_people/search` -
the latter now returns a hard HTTP 422 ("deprecated for API callers"), confirmed
live. If this ever 422s again, check docs.apollo.io/reference/people-api-search
before assuming the query or key is at fault - it has moved once already.

Search results can carry only a first name (Apollo obfuscates last names
in search unless the plan includes full-reveal-in-search - documented, and
confirmed live: same account, same query, full name via one access path,
first-name-only via another). Attach Contact upgrades this using the SAME
paid reveal call that already gets the email, whenever it has a fuller name
than search did - never downgrades an already-complete name.
